text: which was: Or, in which he, etc.
made we not our prayer before: Heb. intreated the face
gotten thee renown: Heb. made thee a name
which is called by thy name: Heb. whereupon thy Name is called | present: Heb. cause to fall
swiftly: Heb. with weariness or flight
to give thee skill and understanding: Heb. to make thee skillful of understanding
commandment: Heb. word | greatly beloved: Heb. a man of desires
to finish: Or, to restrain | prophecy: Heb. prophet
shall be built again: Heb. shall return and be built | wall: Or, breach or ditch | in troublous times: Heb. in strait of times
but not for himself: Or, shall have nothing | desolations are determined: Or, it shall be cut off by desolations
for the overspreading of abominations: Or, with the abominable armies
